All 300 units have been built and are shipping together, and Magic M. expects them to leave the factory on November 12. Your Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA line comes in the same parcel to (address hidden). We'll email you tracking as soon as your miner ships to you. You can follow the shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The B30 switch on your KBOX order, Shop····, is still with the team.
